description: Source code for the LSM6DSL sensor hub driver in Zephyr RTOS, managing external sensor initialization, communication, and configuration.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_lis2mdl_init
methods.description: Initializes LIS2MDL magnetometer sensor over I2C.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_lis3mdl_init
methods.description: Initializes LIS3MDL magnetometer sensor over I2C.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_lps22hb_init
methods.description: Initializes LPS22HB baro/temp sensor over I2C.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_wait_completed
methods.description: Waits for sensor hub operation to complete based on accelerometer frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_embedded_en
methods.description: Enables or disables embedded sensor configuration.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_read_embedded_reg
methods.description: Reads a register from the embedded sensor, used for debugging.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_enable
methods.description: Enables the sensor hub and related functionalities.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_disable
methods.description: Disables the sensor hub and related functionalities.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_read_slave_reg
methods.description: Reads a register from a slave device via sensor hub.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_write_slave_reg
methods.description: Writes to a register of a slave device via sensor hub.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_set_data_channel
methods.description: Configures data channels for external sensors.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_read_external_chip
methods.description: Reads data from an external sensor chip.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_shub_init_external_chip
methods.description: Initializes external sensor chips connected via sensor hub.
